response.original_title: Do dost aur purani yaadein (English Title: Two friends and old memories)
response.overview: In this humorous, nostalgic conversation, two friends look back on a childhood crush named Riya. One recalls going to school even on the day his grandfather died just to see her, and buying Kinder Joys for her—then eating them himself. They laugh over an awkward memory in which he told Riya he still sucked his thumb, after which she avoided shaking his hand.
response.title: Do dost aur purani yaadein (English Title: Two friends and old memories)
